member.summary:
A cross-channel redirect banner (LIVE_CHAT_BANNER_TYPE_CROSS_CHANNEL_REDIRECT). Two distinct variants exist — check to tell them apart:
— the stream ended and the channel owner is sending viewers away to another live stream ("Don't miss out!…"). The "Go now" button carries a direct watchEndpoint; is non-null. Pass it to IYTLiveChat.Start(liveId: ...) to follow immediately.

where is — a new poll just opened; choices have 0 votes.
where is — live vote-count updates; use to correlate.
— the poll panel was dismissed and the poll is over.

member.summary:
Fires when a viewer engagement system message is received (liveChatViewerEngagementMessageRenderer). These are YouTube-generated notices that appear in the chat feed but are not user messages. Inspect to distinguish variants:
